buffs.name: Defensive Spin (+4 Dodge AC on hit)
Axe to Grind (+1 dmg vs sole foe threatened)

feats.name: Flurry of Blows
feats.shortDesc: Full-attack: make one additional attack at highest BAB (+10/+10). Can spend 1 ki for a third attack.
feats.fullDesc: As a full-attack action, Agelmund can make one additional attack at his highest base attack bonus (+10). This stacks with haste. He can use unarmed strikes or monk special weapons in any combination. Does not take multi-weapon penalties.

feats.name: Stunning Fist (5/day, DC 14)
feats.shortDesc: Declare before attack roll. On hit: Fort DC 14 or target stunned 1 round. At level 4+ can fatigue instead.
feats.fullDesc: You must declare use before rolling. If the attack hits and the target fails Fort DC 14, it is stunned for 1 round (or fatigued — Agelmund's choice). A stunned creature drops held items, cannot act, loses DEX to AC, and takes −2 penalty to AC. 5 uses per day.

feats.name: Ki Pool (6 pts)
feats.shortDesc: Supernatural energy pool. 1 pt = extra flurry attack. 2 pts = Wholeness of Body (1d8+5 healing).
feats.fullDesc: Ki pool = 1/2 monk level (2) + WIS mod (2) + Extra Ki feat (2) = 6 pts. Unarmed strikes count as magic weapons. Spend 1 ki as a swift action to gain one extra unarmed strike in a flurry. Spend 2 ki as a standard action for Wholeness of Body: heal 1d8+5 damage.

feats.name: Jabbing Style
feats.shortDesc: When you hit a target with an unarmed strike that you already hit this round, deal +1d6 extra damage.
feats.fullDesc: A cluster of quick strikes deals more damage than a single blow. When you hit a target with an unarmed strike AND you have hit that target with an unarmed strike previously that same round, you deal an extra 1d6 points of damage to that target.

feats.name: Defensive Spin (Style Strike)
feats.shortDesc: On flurry hit with fist: gain +4 dodge bonus to AC against target until start of next turn.
feats.fullDesc: The monk spins about, confounding his foe. If the attack hits, the monk gains a +4 dodge bonus to AC against any attacks made by the target of the style strike until the start of his next turn. This bonus does not stack with itself. The monk must attack with a fist to use this style strike.

feats.name: Combat Stamina (7 pts)
feats.shortDesc: Spend up to 5 stamina for competence bonus on attack rolls, or use combat tricks.
feats.fullDesc: After you make an attack roll with a manufactured weapon, unarmed strike, or natural weapon, but before results are revealed, spend up to 5 stamina to gain a competence bonus equal to points spent. Can also spend stamina points on combat tricks associated with combat feats (Dodge, Deflect Arrows, Improved Grapple, Stunning Fist).

feats.name: Improved Grapple (Granted)
feats.shortDesc: No AoO when grappling. +2 on grapple CMB checks and +2 CMD vs. grapple attempts.
feats.fullDesc: You do not provoke an attack of opportunity when performing a grapple combat maneuver. You receive a +2 bonus on checks made to grapple a foe and a +2 bonus to CMD whenever an opponent tries to grapple you. Grapple CMB: +12 (BAB 5 + STR 5 + 2 Improved Grapple).

feats.name: Deflect Arrows (Granted)
feats.shortDesc: Once per round, with a free hand, deflect one ranged weapon attack to take no damage.
feats.fullDesc: You must have at least one hand free. Once per round when you would be hit with a ranged weapon attack, you may deflect it to take no damage. You must be aware of the attack and not flat-footed. Unusually massive projectiles and natural/spell attacks cannot be deflected.

feats.name: Dodge
feats.shortDesc: +1 dodge bonus to AC (already included in AC 17).
feats.fullDesc: Your training allows you to react swiftly. You gain a +1 dodge bonus to your AC. A condition that makes you lose your DEX bonus to AC also makes you lose the benefits of this feat.

feats.name: Extra Ki
feats.fullDesc: You can use your ki pool more times per day than most. Your ki pool increases by 2.

feats.name: Alertness
feats.shortDesc: +2 on Perception and Sense Motive checks.
feats.fullDesc: You often notice things that others might miss. You get a +2 bonus on Perception and Sense Motive skill checks. If you have 10 or more ranks in one of these skills, the bonus increases to +4 for that skill.

classAbilities.name: Monk AC Bonus (Unarmored)
classAbilities.description: While unarmored and unencumbered, Agelmund adds WIS modifier (+2) to AC and CMD, plus +1 at 4th level. His AC of 17 = 10 + DEX(+2) + Dodge(+1) + WIS/Monk bonus(+4). Touch AC equals total AC (17) since he wears no armor.

classAbilities.name: Purity of Body (Lvl 5)
classAbilities.description: At 5th level, a monk gains immunity to all diseases, including supernatural and magical diseases.

classAbilities.name: Style Strike (Defensive Spin)
classAbilities.description: At 5th level, a monk can learn one type of style strike. Whenever he makes a flurry of blows, he can designate one unarmed strike as a style strike (Defensive Spin: +4 dodge AC vs target on hit).

classAbilities.name: Evasion
classAbilities.description: If Agelmund succeeds on a Reflex saving throw against an attack that normally deals half damage on a successful save, he instead takes no damage.

classAbilities.name: Fast Movement (Ex)
classAbilities.description: At 3rd level, a monk gains an enhancement bonus to land speed (+10 ft at 5th level, total 40 ft). Lost if wearing armor or carrying a medium or heavy load.

classAbilities.name: Still Mind
classAbilities.description: +2 bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells and effects.

classAbilities.name: Wholeness of Body (Ki Power)
classAbilities.description: Heal own wounds as a standard action: spend 2 ki to heal 1d8 + monk level (1d8+5 HP).

inventory.name: Masterwork Knuckle Axe
inventory.description: Exotic light weapon dealing 1d6 slashing damage, ×3 crit. Masterwork (+1 attack).

inventory.name: Oil, 1 Pint Flask
inventory.description: Flask of oil, can be thrown as a splash weapon or used for hooded lantern.

inventory.name: Bedroll
inventory.description: Bedroll for resting in the wild.

inventory.name: Lantern, Hooded
inventory.description: Bright illumination 30 ft., shadowy illumination 60 ft.
